likely_causes: Claude API errors: 429 rate limits, 529 overloaded, 5xx
Bad deploy of the drafting API or a new prompt version
diagnosis_steps: Open the SLO overview dashboard and identify the failing status codes
Check whether AL-6 is also firing (dependency problem)
Search logs by Claude request id for error types (rate_limit_error, overloaded_error, api_error)
Compare the start time with the last deploy and prompt version change
remediation_steps: Dependency: confirm template fallback mode is active and notify Claims Platform
Claude 429/529: pause the backlog batch drafter and let SDK retries with backoff absorb bursts
Deploy regression: roll back to the last good release or prompt pin
entries.escalation: AI Delivery Team on-call; Claims Platform for ClaimCore; vendor support with request ids for sustained API errors

likely_causes: Cache misses on the policy prefix (prefix no longer byte-stable)
Higher effort setting or model change
diagnosis_steps: Compare output tokens per draft by prompt version
Check the cache-read ratio on the dashboard
Compare DRAFT_MODEL and DRAFT_EFFORT with the pinned values
remediation_steps: Roll back the prompt version if output length jumped
Restore a byte-stable prefix (no timestamps, fixed section order) and pre-warm the cache

likely_causes: Shift in letter mix or claim data
diagnosis_steps: Break the judge pass rate down by letter type and prompt version
Read 10 failing samples next to their rubric scores
Check the latest judge calibration agreement
remediation_steps: Roll back the offending prompt version
Add the failing cases to the eval suite before fixing the prompt
Re-calibrate the judge if agreement fell below 85%
entries.escalation: AI Quality lead; Claims Ops content lead for prompt changes

likely_causes: Longer outputs or more regenerations per letter
diagnosis_steps: Split spend into cache reads, cache writes, uncached input and output
Confirm the pinned model and effort
remediation_steps: Fix prefix stability to restore cache reads
Tighten output length budgets per letter type
Move eligible backlog volume to the batch drafter

likely_causes: Drafting prompt change introducing coverage-like phrasing
Unusual letter mix, such as many near-denial letters
diagnosis_steps: Sample 20 blocked drafts and label true vs false positives
Check recent p_draft_* and p_guard version changes
Compare the block rate by letter type
remediation_steps: True positives: roll back the drafting prompt
False positives: roll back p_guard and add the cases to its eval suite
Never disable the guardrail to restore throughput
entries.escalation: Compliance (notify within 4 hours) and AI Delivery Team

likely_causes: Shared ClaimCore rate limit exhausted (50 rps)
diagnosis_steps: Check ClaimCore status and error codes (5xx vs 429 vs 401)
Compare request rate with the shared 50 rps limit
Verify the client secret in Vault
remediation_steps: Confirm the circuit breaker opened and template mode is active
Rotate the secret if authentication fails
